name: newtype_u32
notes: A newtype has no wire overhead and uses its u32 inner encoding.

name: alias_u16
notes: An alias has no wire overhead and uses its u16 target encoding.

name: nested_optional_some_none_u16
schema:
namespace test.nested_optional_none
message M { v @0 : optional<optional<u16>> }
notes: The outer present bit and inner absent bit pack contiguously as 1 0 before final padding.

name: nested_optional_some_u16
schema:
namespace test.nested_optional_some
message M { v @0 : optional<optional<u16>> }
notes: The two present bits pack contiguously as 1 1, then the stream aligns before little-endian u16.

name: non_exhaustive_enum_unknown
notes: A non-exhaustive enum uses at least 8 bits and preserves an unknown ordinal.

name: flags_unknown_bits
notes: Unknown flag bits are preserved in the generated numeric wrapper.

name: map_i16_canonical_order
schema:
namespace test.map_i16
message M { v @0 : map<i16, u8> }
notes: Entries supplied in reverse numeric order encode with -1 before 2.

name: set_u16_canonical_order
schema:
namespace test.set_u16
message M { v @0 : set<u16> }
notes: Set elements supplied in reverse numeric order encode as 1 then 2.

name: nested_optional_map_set
schema:
namespace test.nested_wire
message M { v @0 : optional<map<u8, set<u16>>> }
notes: Present optional flushes before a one-entry map whose set is canonically sorted.
